effect.pohsmp_core.dread.description: Slowness and weakness after a nightmare.

item.pohsmp_core.ember_blade.desc1: Hits heat the cold blade until it catches fire; the burning sword builds up heat
item.pohsmp_core.ember_blade.desc3: Last Ember turns the sword into a fire whip until the heat dies; the whip has Fire Vortex
skill.pohsmp_core.ember_special.tooltip: Only at full heat. Sword: the blade into the ground, three waves of fire pillars. Whip: a full turn, a ring of fire throws everyone back.
spell.pohsmp_core.ark.guide: A dome of light over the cast point. Players inside cannot die, heal, and are cleansed of harmful effects at the moment of the cast. Enemies at its border are blinded.
spell.pohsmp_core.ashless_flame.guide: A blue circle flares under the target, a pillar of blue fire strikes, and three rings of flame run outward.
spell.pohsmp_core.banishment.guide: Space throws everyone around the caster far away, to a safe spot on the ground.
spell.pohsmp_core.blood_gift.guide: The caster gives their own health to the target, never dropping below 1. Heals anyone.
spell.pohsmp_core.blood_mark.guide: Marks the target: whoever hurts it heals for a share of the damage dealt.
spell.pohsmp_core.blood_moon.guide: A crimson moon rises over the caster. Enemies around lose health every second; the caster heals for all of it.
spell.pohsmp_core.countdown.guide: A clock face hangs over the target for 10 s and counts every wound it takes. When time runs out, all of it strikes again at once, through armor.
spell.pohsmp_core.coven_arrival.guide: A Coven seal. The first use marks the arena. Shift+right click a creature with the scroll to take it into the retinue. Then, from afar: a portal opens on the arena, the retinue and the caster step out, and space over the arena closes into a dome. Everyone around watches.
spell.pohsmp_core.disintegration.guide: For ten seconds the caster weaves circles around the target. The target freezes above the ground, the circles close in, and it dissolves into light. Damage cannot interrupt the cast.
spell.pohsmp_core.disintegration_replica: A copy of the holy Disintegration. 10 s of prayer bind the target in a scarlet cylinder of seals, then a pillar of light. Never kills.
spell.pohsmp_core.divine_taboo.guide: For twenty-five seconds a column of light rises to a seal in the sky while everyone around watches. Then a ban falls: nobody but the caster may cast spells, and everyone inside is cleansed of harmful effects.
spell.pohsmp_core.downfall.guide: Only from the Staff of Downfall. For 25 seconds the caster tears the world open: every player nearby is frozen, cannot be hurt and watches the rift being born. Then a rift to the Nether opens for a minute where the caster was looking. Whatever touches it falls through. There is no way back.
spell.pohsmp_core.eight_shields.guide: Eight shields circle the caster and share one pool that absorbs damage; they break one by one.
spell.pohsmp_core.eternal_blizzard.guide: A wall of everlasting snowstorm rises around the caster. Inside, the cold binds every step, harder the closer to the wall; the frost bites to the bone, and the storm itself drags back into the circle.
spell.pohsmp_core.explosion.guide: A long chant: seven circles light up in the sky one by one, then everything burns in a huge explosion. The caster collapses afterwards.
spell.pohsmp_core.falling_sun.guide: A ball of fire falls from the sky where you look, after a warning circle. Blocks stay intact.
spell.pohsmp_core.fate_star.guide: A constellation lights up above the target, then a star falls. A random tarot card decides how.
spell.pohsmp_core.fire_whip.guide: A whip of flame lashes an arc in front of the caster, burning everyone in it and pulling the nearest one in.
spell.pohsmp_core.forbidding_seal.guide: A circle of six runes under the target. While it holds, no spells and no potions. Leaving the circle breaks a rune.
spell.pohsmp_core.frost_spike_wall.guide: A wall of ice spikes across your view. Touching it hurts, slows and pushes back. Sneak to raise a ring around yourself.
spell.pohsmp_core.frozen_hour.guide: Everything around except the caster stops: creatures, projectiles, items, fire. Damage to the frozen is stored and lands all at once when time moves again.
spell.pohsmp_core.gale_ward.guide: A whirlwind around the caster pushes creatures away and deflects projectiles.
spell.pohsmp_core.glacial_tombs.guide: Everyone around the caster is locked in ice.
spell.pohsmp_core.grasping_garden.guide: Roots grab everyone where you look, and allied creepers sprout nearby to hunt your foes. They burst without breaking blocks.
spell.pohsmp_core.ground_shock.guide: An electric ring runs along the ground from the caster, shocking and paralysing whoever it touches. Jump over it.
spell.pohsmp_core.heaven_fall.guide: The sky darkens, then meteors fall around the cast point. Each is marked by a burning circle a second before it lands. No blocks are broken.
spell.pohsmp_core.hemorrhage.guide: The target bleeds: every block it moves hurts it. Standing still does not.
spell.pohsmp_core.illusion.guide: The caster leaves a double behind and briefly vanishes. Mobs hunting the caster go after the double; it bursts when struck or reached.
spell.pohsmp_core.judgement.guide: A circle of light marks the target; a second later a beam strikes it from the sky. Undead take double.
spell.pohsmp_core.lightning_rod.guide: A glowing rod rises where the caster looks and strikes every enemy closer than 5 blocks once a second.
spell.pohsmp_core.living_shield.guide: The caster takes the hits meant for nearby players: damage they would take after armor goes to the caster.
spell.pohsmp_core.magic_madness.guide: Stronger magic, but the body stops obeying: it walks to the nearest creature, strikes it and casts spells from your book. It cannot be stopped early.
spell.pohsmp_core.milky_way.guide: "Even the farthest stars will hear my call, and the sky will become my weapon." A galaxy is born and the spiral of the Milky Way bursts from the hand: it draws in, wounds, slows and throws up enemies.
spell.pohsmp_core.mirror_prison.guide: The target is shut in a mirror cube. Its strikes and spells turn back on itself, nothing outside can reach it, and it cannot leave.
spell.pohsmp_core.nightmare_cradle.guide: The target falls asleep into a nightmare. A hit wakes it and lands harder; left alone, it wakes in dread.
spell.pohsmp_core.oblivion_blades.guide: Dark blades circle the caster. Every half second one flies at the nearest enemy and comes back.
spell.pohsmp_core.overload.guide: A mark stores all damage the target takes and after 3 seconds discharges into it and everyone near.
spell.pohsmp_core.phantom_trap.guide: An invisible trap where the caster looks. Spectral chains seize the first one to step on it. Only the caster sees where it lies.
spell.pohsmp_core.sage_barrier.guide: Only from the Staff of the Silent Witch. A dome around you that moves with you: projectiles from outside go out on its surface, and rays and touches at those inside fail.
spell.pohsmp_core.sanctuary.guide: A dome of light around the caster: allies inside heal every second, enemies are pushed out.
spell.pohsmp_core.scarlet_cut.guide: Three to five scarlet cuts slash along the caster’s gaze, one after another. Under each a crack opens in the ground and a second later bursts with shards, throwing everyone near it up.
spell.pohsmp_core.silent_gate.guide: Only from the Silent Witch's staff and in her full outfit. For 50 seconds, to music, a white gate slowly emerges from a magic circle in the sky; everyone within 128 blocks hears only this music and watches the scene. The gate opens, and rays strike every foe across the area. Afterwards, Silence: Silent Gate cannot be cast again for 3 minutes.
spell.pohsmp_core.silent_volley.guide: Only from the Staff of the Silent Witch. Small seals rise in a fan behind you; at the end of the cast each one shoots an arrow of light at its own enemy.
spell.pohsmp_core.singularity.guide: A black sphere where the caster looks. It pulls everything in and pins it down, then collapses.
spell.pohsmp_core.soul_devour.guide: For twenty-five seconds the caster draws the soul out of the target while everyone around watches. The target cannot move and dies at the end. Nothing saves it.
spell.pohsmp_core.space_closure.guide: A Coven seal. For twenty seconds a seal forms over the caster and everyone around watches. Then space closes into a dome: nobody can enter, leave or move through it, not even the caster. Inside, only the caster can work magic.
spell.pohsmp_core.spore_cloud.guide: A cloud of spores where the caster looks: slows, sickens and hurts. The infected pass spores to their neighbours.
spell.pohsmp_core.star_fall.guide: A long cast at the point you look at. Everyone nearby watches the star fall from the sky. The impact hurts and throws back everything around, hardest in the centre, and leaves a glowing crater for a while. No blocks are broken.
spell.pohsmp_core.swap.guide: The caster and the target trade places. The target is left dizzy for a moment.
spell.pohsmp_core.wind_ascension.guide: The caster rises in a column of light striking foes with beams from the sky, then descends and heals allies.
spell.pohsmp_core.wind_mark.guide: A gust flies forward and marks the first target hit; the wind throws it about 5 blocks up every 2 s.
spell.pohsmp_core.wind_spears.guide: Only from the Staff of the Silent Witch. Clear spears of wind appear over your shoulders, one for each target, hang for a moment and strike every enemy right in the head at once.
spell.pohsmp_core.worgan_flame.guide: Only from the Staff of the Silent Witch. The shadow of a black dragon rises over your right shoulder and breathes black flame. Water cannot put it out.
spell.pohsmp_core.world_rift.guide: The ground splits along the caster's gaze. Whoever stands on the crack is thrown up; a second later pillars of darkness rise from it.

spell.pohsmp_core.soul_seal.guide: For ten seconds a lock-seal gathers above the player you look at; chains of light reach for their chest and press the seal in. The sealed player loses magic forever, even after death. Only Blessing can lift it.
spell.pohsmp_core.blessing.guide: Ten seconds of prayer: a halo opens above the target and soft light descends. Removes all harmful effects, burning, freezing, marks and curses, and the Soul Seal. With no target it blesses the caster.
effect.pohsmp_core.soul_seal.description: The soul is sealed: no casting of any kind, spells or scrolls. Milk, totems and death do not remove it; only Blessing can.

spell.pohsmp_core.mirror_images.guide: The air cracks like a mirror and three copies of the caster step out. They run, jump, swing and cast like real players, and the caster quietly swaps places with one of them. A copy takes two or three hits, then breaks into a puff.
spell.pohsmp_core.false_step.guide: For a second and a half the caster vanishes from enemies completely, armor, shadow, name and map marker included, while a copy keeps running the same way and even swings. Meanwhile the caster dashes 8 blocks where they look.
spell.pohsmp_core.veil.guide: For ten seconds the air shimmers within 6 blocks. Enemies inside see the caster and allies doubled: false silhouettes walk beside the real ones, and the real ones blink out now and then. A blow at a false one hits nothing.
spell.pohsmp_core.phantom_pain.guide: A cracked heart lights up over the target. For six seconds its health drops twice as fast as it really does: half the damage is an illusion. If the target survives the mark, the illusory damage comes back in pearly sparks; if it dies, the death is real.
spell.pohsmp_core.borrowed_face.guide: The caster passes a palm over their face and for thirty seconds looks to everyone like another player on the server (skin and name of whoever they last looked at, or a random one), or a mob of their height. The disguise drops on any attack or cast.
spell.pohsmp_core.mirror_labyrinth.guide: The palms draw a square and strike the ground: a dome of 14 blocks stands for 20 seconds. Enemies inside see solid mirror walls; they can pass through, but the shards wound and push them back. The caster is reflected in the walls, left and right are swapped. The caster and allies do not see the walls.
spell.pohsmp_core.waking_nightmare.guide: A seal of empty eyes opens over the target. For twelve seconds everyone around it, allies, enemies, mobs and the caster too, looks like the same faceless monster, and names are hidden. Strike an ally and the wound is real.
spell.pohsmp_core.butterfly_dream.guide: Twelve seconds of casting: a butterfly is born in the palms and rises to the sky, growing into the Heavenly Butterfly. For two minutes every enemy within 64 blocks sleeps a quiet dream: left and right are swapped, glowing flowers bloom in their steps, the dream whispers to them, and the caster and allies are invisible to them (a hit or a cast shows a flickering outline for a second). Everyone else sees a cocoon of butterflies over the sleepers. No damage in the dream is real - only illusory health falls; whoever «dies» in the dream wakes elsewhere in it. Nothing happens at the waking: it was just a dream. Damage from outside the dream is real.
effect.pohsmp_core.phantom_pain.descript: Half the damage you take is an illusion: it comes back if you survive the mark.
effect.pohsmp_core.waking_nightmare.desc: Everyone around looks like a faceless monster; names are hidden.
effect.pohsmp_core.butterfly_dream.descr: You sleep a quiet dream: some enemies are invisible, their hits are not real, and death here only wakes you elsewhere in the dream.
effect.pohsmp_core.borrowed_face.descrip: Everyone sees someone else. The disguise drops on an attack or a cast.
fx.pohsmp_core.butterfly_dream.title: BUTTERFLY DREAM

spell.pohsmp_core.erased_name.guide: Forbidden magic of the Creation tier. For fifteen seconds the caster writes the name of the player they are looking at in the air and strikes it out: the world around the target fades, strike-through lines run across them, their outline crumbles into letters — and after a moment of silence the target vanishes into the void. For 10 minutes the world forgets them: no one sees or hears them, they leave the player list, mobs ignore them, their hits are weak and potions do not heal them. You cannot erase yourself. Blessing brings them back early.
effect.pohsmp_core.erased.description: The world has forgotten you: no one sees or hears you, you are not in the player list, mobs ignore you. Your damage ×0.25, potions and regeneration do not heal, totems do not save you, you cannot pick up items. You can still cast. Not removed by milk or death; Blessing lifts it early.

spell.pohsmp_core.world_tree.guide: For twelve seconds, where the caster looks, a sprout breaks through the ground and grows into a giant tree. For 20 seconds roots rise under enemies within 24 blocks, entangle them and slowly drag them to the trunk — a root can be cut or burned. Allies under the crown regenerate. At the end the tree blooms: a cloud of spores poisons and blinds enemies near the trunk.
spell.pohsmp_core.abyss_eye.guide: For twelve seconds the sky above the caster darkens, the clouds swirl and a huge eye opens in them. For 15 seconds enemies under the open sky within 40 blocks hear whispers and lose their sanity (damage every second); whoever looks at the Eye is struck hard and frozen. Hide under a roof and do not look up.
spell.pohsmp_core.last_dawn.guide: For ten seconds dawn burns on the horizon and the sun rises — even at night. For 12 seconds within 30 blocks the caster's allies cannot die, and afterwards they heal half of the damage taken. The undead and mages of Blood and the Forbidden school burn in this light.
effect.pohsmp_core.entangled.description: A root of the World Tree holds you and drags you to the trunk: heavy slowness, no jumping. Break the root with hits or fire.
effect.pohsmp_core.abyss_dread.descripti: Under the open sky the Eye of the Abyss wears down your sanity: damage every second. Do not look at the Eye and get under a roof.
effect.pohsmp_core.dawn_grace.descriptio: While the dawn shines you cannot die; afterwards you heal half of the damage taken.

effect.pohsmp_core.immersion.description: The world around you turns into a nightmare - only for you. The level is the stage: shadows, hallucinations, nightmare.
spell.pohsmp_core.house_that_isnt.guide: For a minute the target falls into an endless dark corridor with doors: the real world is hidden, but it really walks, and the corridor goes with it. Shadows come out of the doors. The caster sees it and strikes for real - to the target it is just one of the shadows.
spell.pohsmp_core.endless_night.guide: For two minutes an endless night with a red moon rises around the caster - only for the enemies inside. Every 8 seconds their nightmare goes one stage deeper. Only real light holds the stage.
spell.pohsmp_core.no_awakening.guide: For seventeen seconds the world drowns in ink, and the caster turns into a monster before everyone's eyes. For five minutes every enemy within 64 blocks lives in the deepest nightmare, thicker every minute. The only way out is to kill the caster.
